Definition: an Ashterathite or inhabitant of Ashtaroth
BiblicalUsage: The Ashterathite is Uzzia, named once, in the list of David's mighty men. He stands among the thirty, a man of Ashtaroth east of Jordan, and the verse gives his name and his town and nothing more.
TheologicalSignificance: Uzzia's hometown is all we know of him, and that carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the reminder that David's mighty men came from both sides of the Jordan, and their towns were worth writing down.
